title: NIMS Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Various Project Nurse III Posts
description: Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) has released an official notification for the recruitment of various Project Nurse III Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the B.Sc. Nursing can grab this chance and apply for the NIMS Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
